title: Design future-detour / out-of-order continuity
description: Design-only (documentation, maybe warnings) — do NOT implement beyond docs. 'Rejoin' is deliberately avoided: it implies a mechanical merge Eshyra cannot perform honestly. Expose it to users as 'play this as a future branch; later decide how, or whether, to reconcile it.' Parent: eshyra-lupf.14.4; depends on eshyra-lupf.14.4.1.
acceptance_criteria:
- Define 'future detour' as an out-of-order branch, not a temporary fork that can be automatically rejoined.
- Document that future-campaign mechanical state is not applied to the earlier campaign until manual reconciliation or catch-up.
- Define data to track to make it intelligible later: source revision, future branch id, parent campaign, intended chronological placement, warnings acknowledged by user.
- Decide whether this requires branching support in the registry schema before implementation.
- Explicitly reject automatic merge of XP, inventory, level, spells, HP, conditions, and campaign-local consequences.
